name: BAW 352 鸟击 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is BAW 352, you are maintaining 11,000 meters, over XIA, squawking 3567, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 BAW 352，正保持 11,000 米，飞越 XIA，应答机 3567，与武汉管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW 352, maintaining 2000 meters, XIA, squawking 3567.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW 352，正保持 2000 米，XIA，应答机 3567。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 10,400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，武汉管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 10,400 米。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, Wuhan Control, descend to 9,200 meters, reduce speed to 270 knots until advised.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，武汉管制，下降至 9,200 米，将速度减至 270 节直至通知。
cards.referenceText: descend to 9,200 meters, reduce speed to less than 270 knots until advised, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 9,200 米，将速度减至低于 270 节直至通知，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: your weather radar observed there was a cumulonimbus ahead, contact Wuhan Control and request offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达观察到前方有积雨云，联系武汉管制，请求向航迹左侧偏置 25 英里，持续 30 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW 352, request offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes due CB ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW 352，因前方有 CB，请求向航迹左侧偏置 25 英里，持续 30 分钟。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, cleared offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes, report clear of CB.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，批准向航迹左侧偏置 25 英里，持续 30 分钟，脱离 CB 后报告。
cards.referenceText: cleared offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准向航迹左侧偏置 25 英里，持续 30 分钟，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: now you are clear of CB, ask Wuhan Control to resume flight route.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已脱离 CB，向武汉管制申请恢复原航路。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW 352, clear of CB, request resume flight route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW 352，已脱离 CB，请求恢复原航路。

cards.audioText: You have received the latest ATIS, saying that the visibility at Wuhan is low, ask Wuhan Approach if your alternate airport Hefei is available for diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已收到最新 ATIS，其中称武汉能见度较低，询问武汉进近你的备降机场合肥是否可用于备降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW 352, the latest ATIS, saying that the visibility at Wuhan is low, is our alternate airport Hefei available for diversion?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW 352，最新 ATIS 称武汉能见度较低，我们的备降机场合肥是否可用于备降？

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 352, Hefei airport is available, confirm you are diverting to Hefei?
B: tell the controller you are not diverting to Hefei at the moment and you still want to fly to Wuhan.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： BAW 352，合肥机场可用，确认你正备降合肥？
B： 告诉管制员你目前不备降合肥，仍想飞往武汉。
cards.referenceText: we are not diverting to Hefei now, we still want to fly to Wuhan, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们现在不备降合肥，仍想飞往武汉，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, roger, track direct to ZF, follow Z FOXTROT-2A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，收到，直飞 ZF，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: track direct to ZF, follow ZF two A Arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, descend and maintain 4,200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，下降并保持 4,200 米，将速度减至最小光洁构型速度。
cards.referenceText: descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 4200 米，将速度减至最小光洁构型速度，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: Now you are established on ILS approach Runway 36R, you are 15 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，距接地点 15 英里，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 352, established ILS Runway 36R, 15 miles from touchdown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 352，已建立 ILS Runway 36R，距接地点 15 英里。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, roger, surface wind calm, RVR touchdown 550 meters, midpoint 600 meters, rollout 500 meters, continue approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，收到，地面静风，RVR 接地区 550 米、中段 600 米、滑跑端 500 米，继续进近 Runway 36R。

cards.audioText: now you are 10 miles from touchdown, ask Wuhan Tower for the cloud information.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你距接地点 10 英里，向武汉塔台询问云况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 352, 10 miles from touchdown, request cloud information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 352，距接地点 10 英里，请求云况信息。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, cloud broken 700 meters, cleared to land Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，碎云 700 米，许可在 Runway 36R 落地。
cards.referenceText: cloud broken 700 meters, cleared to land Runway 36R, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 碎云 700 米，许可在 Runway 36R 落地，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: the weather is deteriorating and below your landing minima, you executed a missed approach, advise tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 天气正在恶化并低于你的着陆最低标准，你已执行复飞，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 352, the weather is deteriorating and below our landing minima, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 352，天气正在恶化并低于我们的着陆最低标准，正在复飞。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，收到，执行标准复飞程序，可以时报告意图。
cards.referenceText: follow the standard missed approach procedure, BAW 352.

cards.audioText: now you are climbing to missed approach altitude, you decide to divert to Hefei Airport, inform Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正爬升至复飞高度，决定备降合肥机场，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 352, request divert to Hefei.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 352，请求备降合肥。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, roger, turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2,400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，收到，右转直飞 LKO，爬升至并保持 2,400 米。
cards.referenceText: turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400 meters, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 LKO，爬升至并保持 2400 米，BAW 352。
